report.text:
# October 2026 operations report

Orders shipped: 41,280, up 6% on September.
Late shipments: 2.1% of orders, against a target of 1.5%. Most were in the last
week, when the Leeds warehouse ran one shift short.
Support tickets: 1,930. Median first reply was 3 hours 10 minutes.
Refunds: 312, in line with September.

Open question: whether to add a temporary shift in Leeds for November.
